title: Attack Configuration
description: Configuration for the ASR knowledge-correlation experiment. Specifies which knowledge assets to include, the target/attacker models, an optional defense, and the (suite, injection_task, user_task) triplets to evaluate.

attacker_model.description: LiteLLM model string for the attacker LLM that generates payloads (e.g. 'gpt-4o-2024-05-13').

target_model.description: LiteLLM model string for the target agent under attack (e.g. 'gpt-4o-2024-05-13').

defense.description: AgentDojo defense name to activate on the target agent, or null for no defense (e.g. 'repeat_user_prompt', 'spotlighting_with_delimiting').

knowledge_pieces.description: Toggle which knowledge assets are included when constructing the attacker's knowledge context. Both legacy (5-piece) and new fine-grained (14-asset) IDs are supported.

operational_rules.description: [Legacy] Include operational rules / system-level instructions of the target agent.

tools_information.description: [Legacy] Include tool descriptions and parameter schemas available to the target agent.

tool_output.description: [Legacy] Include the raw tool output context (with injection placeholder) seen by the target agent.

benign_response.description: Include a sample benign response the target agent would typically produce.

security_guardrails.description: [Legacy] Include details about security guardrails or safety filters applied by the target agent.

tool_names_and_parameters.description: Include the exact names and short descriptions of all tools available to the target agent.

tool_call_schema.description: Include the full JSON argument schemas for each tool, including key names and types.

filters.description: Include information about content-filtering rules that govern what the agent will or will not share.

exception_schema.description: Include the format of error/exception messages that the agent receives from failed tool calls.

behavioral_rules.description: Include the agent's system prompt / operational rules as exactly as possible.

type_of_agent.description: Include a high-level description of the agent's domain and job function.

model_identity.description: Include the identity of the underlying LLM powering the target agent.

guardrails.description: Include the security-specific constraints and prohibitions extracted from the system prompt.

user_persona.description: Include background details about the user interacting with the agent (name, role, company, etc.).

agent_task.description: Include the specific task the agent is currently trying to accomplish for the user.

injected_tool_output.description: Include the tool output(s) where the injection will land, with <<INJECTION_PLACEHOLDER>> marking the exact insertion point.

structural_defenses.description: Include details about conversation-level structural defenses (e.g. delimiter wrapping, user-prompt repetition).

conversation_structure.description: Include a description of how the agent sees its own context window (message roles, ordering, tool call format).

defenses.description: Combined asset: conversation structure + active defense mechanism and bypass hints in a single section.

triplets.description: List of (suite, injection_task_id, user_task_id) triplets to run the experiment against.

items.description: A triplet of [suite_name, injection_task_id, user_task_id]. E.g. ["banking", "injection_task_0", "user_task_0"].
